title: India Government Tenders Scraper
description: Low-cost sample: collect 1 public GeM tender for laptop. GeM uses Residential India routing internally. Optional saved watchlists compare later bounded result windows on the Apify platform; every clean tender still saves and charges each run. CPPP extraction is not implemented.

source.title: Tender Source
source.description: Use gem: the supported source. Legacy cppp returns no records; both can return only GeM records. CPPP extraction is not implemented, even without CAPTCHA. Run-start and applicable platform usage charges can still apply.

keywords.title: Search Keywords
keywords.description: Tender search keywords. Up to 5 keywords are processed sequentially to keep runs cost-safe. Start with one keyword.

department.title: Department / Ministry
department.description: Optional department or ministry text filter.

state.title: State
state.description: Optional state filter from enriched GeM detail PDFs when available.

minValue.title: Minimum Tender Value (INR)
minValue.description: Optional minimum tender value. Records with unknown value are excluded when this filter is used.

maxValue.title: Maximum Tender Value (INR)
maxValue.description: Optional maximum tender value. Records with unknown value are excluded when this filter is used.

dateFrom.title: Date From
dateFrom.description: Optional published-date filter applied after GeM detail PDF enrichment.

dateTo.title: Date To
dateTo.description: Optional published-date filter applied after GeM detail PDF enrichment.

status.title: Tender Status
status.description: Tender status filter. Current limitation: all uses the same ongoing GeM listing as active; it does not combine active and closed tenders.

maxResults.title: Max Results Per Keyword
maxResults.description: Maximum tender records per keyword, up to 50. Start with 1 for a low-cost test.

watchlistName.title: Saved GeM Watchlist Name (Optional)
watchlistName.description: Enable persistent GeM comparison on the Apify platform by reusing this name. Use 1–50 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or number. The first safe result window initializes a baseline; later runs publish GEM-CHANGES for newly observed bids or evidenced material changes. Every clean tender still saves to the Dataset and charges each run, including unchanged bids. Omit for the ordinary scrape. CPPP-only watchlists are unsupported.
